newFindings.title: LocalAppData\HeyClicky\endpoints.json on disk contains only PascalCase keys (ignored by case-sensitive AppBundleConfiguration.LoadConfigured), causing entry-assembly metadata fallback to production Supabase when HEYCLICKY_WORKER_BASE_URL is only a worker override
newFindings.description:
In docs/audit/evidence/ws-ab/system-state-check.json (lines 87-88), the actual file at C:\Users\ubaid\AppData\Local\HeyClicky\endpoints.json on disk contains ONLY PascalCase keys:
{
  "WorkerBaseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8787",
  "SupabaseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8787",
  "SupabaseAnonKey": "kursor-local-anon-key"
}
However, AppBundleConfiguration.LoadConfigured (AppBundleConfiguration.cs:78-80) calls ReadConfigured(rootElement, "workerBaseUrl"), ReadConfigured(rootElement, "supabaseUrl"), and ReadConfigured(rootElement, "supabaseAnonKey") using case-sensitive JsonElement.TryGetProperty! When endpoints.json only has PascalCase keys, all three return null!
Even worse: because scripts/build-dist.ps1 never copies HeyClicky.exe (leaving the original Humansongs, Inc HeyClicky.exe entry assembly in dist/kursor-desktop/HeyClicky.exe), AppBundleConfiguration.WithBuildMetadata(Defaults) (lines 109-145) inspects Assembly.GetEntryAssembly() (HeyClicky.exe), which has baked-in AssemblyMetadata attributes for production HeyClicky! And when start-kursor.ps1 sets $env:HEYCLICKY_WORKER_BASE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8787', ApplyWorkerOverride (lines 91-107) ONLY overrides WorkerBaseUrl — leaving SupabaseUrl and SupabaseAnonKey at whatever WithBuildMetadata returned if endpoints.json failed camelCase lookup!
reproductionSteps: Inspect LocalAppData_HeyClicky_EndpointsJson in docs/audit/evidence/ws-ab/system-state-check.json:87-88 (note it only has PascalCase WorkerBaseUrl, SupabaseUrl, SupabaseAnonKey).
Trace AppBundleConfiguration.LoadConfigured (AppBundleConfiguration.cs:57-89) -> ReadConfigured (lines 147-159) which uses case-sensitive root.TryGetProperty('workerBaseUrl', ...).
newFindings.observedResult: PascalCase-only endpoints.json is silently ignored by ReadConfigured, and ApplyWorkerOverride only overrides WorkerBaseUrl (ignoring HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL and HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY set by start-kursor.ps1:123-124).
newFindings.expectedResult: ReadConfigured in AppBundleConfiguration.cs must check both camelCase and PascalCase property names (or use case-insensitive matching), and ApplyWorkerOverride should also honor HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL and HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
newFindings.remediation: In AppBundleConfiguration.ReadConfigured (lines 147-159), match property names case-insensitively (`foreach (var prop in root.EnumerateObject()) if (string.Equals(prop.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ...`), and support HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL / HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY environment overrides.

newFindings.category: Packaging Script Exit Code & Portable Archive Bloat
newFindings.title: scripts/package-portable.ps1 and scripts/build-dist.ps1 leave non-zero robocopy $LASTEXITCODE (1-7), and package-portable.ps1 bundles docs/audit/ and unusable build-dist.ps1 without src/desktop
newFindings.description:
1. Non-zero $LASTEXITCODE from robocopy: In scripts/package-portable.ps1:73 (`$null = robocopy $DistDir $DistStage /E ...`) and scripts/build-dist.ps1:46, robocopy sets $LASTEXITCODE to 1-3 on successful file copy. Because Compress-Archive is a PowerShell cmdlet (which does not reset $LASTEXITCODE), package-portable.ps1 exits with $LASTEXITCODE = 1 (or 3), causing automated callers or CI pipelines checking $LASTEXITCODE to treat a successful build/package as a failure.
2. Broken scripts & audit artifacts bundled in portable zip: scripts/package-portable.ps1:46 copies all of scripts/ (including build-dist.ps1 and overlay-and-launch.ps1) into the portable zip while omitting src/desktop/, so running scripts/build-dist.ps1 inside an extracted portable zip fails with 'Solution file not found'. Line 50 also copies the entire docs/ directory (including internal reverse-engineering specs and audit evidence) into the end-user portable zip.
reproductionSteps: Verify that robocopy sets $LASTEXITCODE = 1 when copying files and neither script resets `global:LASTEXITCODE = 0` or checks `if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { throw ... }`.
newFindings.observedResult: robocopy failures ($LASTEXITCODE >= 8) are not checked, successful runs leave $LASTEXITCODE = 1..3, and the portable zip contains broken build scripts and internal docs.
newFindings.expectedResult: Check `if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { throw "robocopy failed with code $LASTEXITCODE" } else { $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0 }`, and copy only runtime-applicable scripts into the portable stage.
newFindings.remediation: Validate robocopy exit codes (`< 8`) and reset `$global:LASTEXITCODE = 0` in `scripts/build-dist.ps1` and `scripts/package-portable.ps1`, and exclude source-only build scripts and `docs/audit/` from the portable zip.

newFindings.category: Production Installer Fallback / Upstream Binary Execution
newFindings.title: start-kursor.ps1 automatically launches proprietary executable-file\HeyClicky-Setup.exe (Humansongs, Inc Velopack installer) if dist\kursor-desktop\HeyClicky.exe is missing
newFindings.description:
In start-kursor.ps1:49-56, if `dist\kursor-desktop\HeyClicky.exe` does not exist and `scripts\build-dist.ps1` throws an error (e.g. .NET 9 SDK is not installed), the catch block swallows the error with `Write-Warning "Desktop build step skipped: $_"`. Then at lines 126-135, `start-kursor.ps1` falls back to:
`elseif (Test-Path $InstallerExe) { Start-Process -FilePath $InstallerExe }`
where `$InstallerExe` is `executable-file\HeyClicky-Setup.exe` — the unmodified, Authenticode-signed Humansongs, Inc Velopack installer! Executing `HeyClicky-Setup.exe` installs the unpatched upstream HeyClicky v1.1.5 application into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\HeyClickyApp\current` and launches it directly against HeyClicky's production cloud (`https://api.heyclicky.com` and `https://mrpvynsdsnimuisyhkow.supabase.co`).
reproductionSteps: Trace execution when dist\kursor-desktop\HeyClicky.exe and %LOCALAPPDATA%\HeyClickyApp\current\HeyClicky.exe are absent and build-dist.ps1 fails.
newFindings.observedResult: start-kursor.ps1 silently swallows the build failure and launches `executable-file\HeyClicky-Setup.exe`, installing and starting the unpatched upstream HeyClicky client.
newFindings.expectedResult: Never execute `executable-file\HeyClicky-Setup.exe` from `start-kursor.ps1`; if `dist\kursor-desktop\HeyClicky.exe` is missing and cannot be built, fail with a clear diagnostic error.
newFindings.remediation: Remove the `$InstallerExe` (`executable-file\HeyClicky-Setup.exe`) fallback at `start-kursor.ps1:126,132-135` and surface build failures directly.

newFindings.title: Pass 1 AUD-N-001 missed that EARS_PRIMARY_PROVIDER, MOUTH_PRIMARY_PROVIDER, and DICTATION_CLEANUP_PROVIDER in .env.example are partially/completely unwired in voice.ts, and start-kursor.ps1 sets unread HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL / HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
newFindings.description: In Pass 1, `docs-audit.json` classified `EARS_PRIMARY_PROVIDER` and `DICTATION_CLEANUP_PROVIDER` as 'used in backend code' only because `src/backend/src/routes/worker.ts:201-208` echoes their strings in the static `/config/runtime-models` response. In reality, `src/backend/src/routes/voice.ts` (which implements all STT and Dictation Cleanup endpoints) NEVER reads `process.env.EARS_PRIMARY_PROVIDER` or `process.env.DICTATION_CLEANUP_PROVIDER`! Similarly, `start-kursor.ps1:123-124` sets `$env:HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL` and `$env:HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, neither of which is read anywhere in the C# desktop codebase (`AppBundleConfiguration.cs` only checks `HEYCLICKY_WORKER_BASE_URL`).
newFindings.observedResult: Setting `EARS_PRIMARY_PROVIDER` or `DICTATION_CLEANUP_PROVIDER` in `.env` has zero effect on `voice.ts` routing, and setting `HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL` / `HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` in `start-kursor.ps1` has zero effect on the C# client.
newFindings.expectedResult: Wire `EARS_PRIMARY_PROVIDER` and `DICTATION_CLEANUP_PROVIDER` into `voice.ts`, and wire `HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL` / `HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` into `AppBundleConfiguration.cs`.
newFindings.remediation: Read `process.env.EARS_PRIMARY_PROVIDER` and `process.env.DICTATION_CLEANUP_PROVIDER` in `src/backend/src/routes/voice.ts`, and read `HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_URL` / `HEYCLICKY_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` in `AppBundleConfiguration.ApplyWorkerOverride`.
